name: scholar-workflow
description: Human-first scholarly knowledge, reproducible research projects, and a typed local Hub control plane for Zotero, Obsidian, Codex, and cmux.

interface.shortDescription: Local research Hub, resources, and workflows
interface.longDescription: Browse typed Papers, Projects, Tools, and knowledge contexts in a local Hub; maintain readable paper analyses; initialize reproducible research projects; and coordinate bounded work across agent runtimes.
defaultPrompt: Survey a research topic and build a literature map.
Find a paper, check my Zotero library, and import it safely.
Analyze a saved paper and update my research notes.
Initialize a new project with the standard Git-managed skeleton.
